description: Repairs r-par-1/order-distinct-without-order-by: GetRows(100) read 100 of 256 rows. Asks, without ORDER BY, in what order SELECT DISTINCT k, DISTINCT k, s, DISTINCTROW k, DISTINCT TOP 3 k and DISTINCT k ORDER BY k DESC return rows for OT5, OT2, OT3 and OT4, each read by one GetRows(300) (more than the 256 rows) with EOF read after it. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-par is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
